chapter_title: Glimpses of the Past & Macavity: The Mystery Cat
executive_summary: Four observant brothers traveling to Ujjain describe a lost camel's exact traits (lame, blind in one eye, missing a tooth, carrying wheat and honey) without ever having seen it. Accused of theft by the camel's owner, they demonstrate before the King of Ujjain how they inferred each trait purely from roadside tracks and insect activity, proving their innocence and earning positions as royal advisers.
